title: How to Automate Invoice Matching for Accounts Payable (2-Way & 3-Way)
summary: Configure automated invoice matching without writing a single line of code: 1) Set up Data Extraction 2) Establish validation rules 2) Design approval workflow 4) Connect to your ERP system
body_text: Every invoice that comes in, your team has to check it against a purchase order, and sometimes a receipt as well, before it can be paid. As they pile up, keeping up with these checks gets harder, small mistakes or duplicate payments start creating serious problems. The good news? This repetitive check can now run on autopilot, thanks to AI. What used to take hours is now quickly done in minutes. This guide will show you how to easily automate invoice matching, step by step. What Is Automated Invoice Matching? Automated invoice matching uses software to check invoices against other records, like purchase orders or receipts, instantly in one workflow. This means invoices move through approval faster with little to no manual effort. In practice, here’s what happens every time an invoice arrives: Capture : Invoice, along with PO and receipt, is retrieved via email, upload, or scan Extract : All data is pulled out and centralized in one place without manual input Match : Data is cross-checked against your matching rules, whether that’s 2-way or 3-way matching Flag or approve : Clean invoices move forward automatically, mismatches get flagged for review Post : Approved invoices are pushed to your accounting or ERP system for payment Documents You Can Automate Matching With Besides the invoice, other documents required for accounts payable vary by business. One team may only need a purchase order, another adds receipts or pricing agreements. And it doesn’t matter what format they arrive in, scanned, PDF, email, e-invoice, or a photo taken on the go. Here’s what usually gets automated: Purchase orders The original approved order, used to confirm price, quantity, and terms. Vendor quotations The initial quoted price, used to confirm the PO and invoice reflect what was agreed. Goods receipt notes Confirmation that the goods or services were actually received, used in 3-way matching. Delivery notes Shipment confirmation from the vendor, used to verify what was delivered against the order. Contracts or pricing agreements A document used to confirm negotiated rates match what’s billed. Essential Technology for Automated Invoice Matching Several core technologies work together to make automated matching possible. Each one plays a different role in the process. AI OCR Data Extraction Before any matching can happen, the system needs to read the document. Intelligent OCR (optical character recognition) converts scanned or image-based documents into readable text, accurately extracting all the specific fields that matter regardless of layout. Rules Engines Rules engines apply your matching logic, tolerance thresholds, approval hierarchies, and what counts as a match versus a mismatch. This is where 2-way, 3-way, or 4-way matching comes into play. Routing Automation No more manually forwarding invoices and chasing approvals. Routing automation skips that step, sending invoices to the right next process based on preset conditions, outcomes, and approval level. How to Automate Invoice Matching Efficiently Setting up invoice matching automation doesn’t have to be a lengthy or complex project. The best invoice matching solutions are designed to simplify implementation as much as processing. With Fintelite AI , getting started is easy. Automate the entire process of invoice matching without writing a single line of code, and go live in minutes. 1. Define the documents to process Choose the documents involved in your invoice matching workflow, such as invoices, purchase orders (POs), goods receipt notes (GRNs), delivery notes, or other supporting documents. Fintelite’s AI extracts the required data from each document, even when layouts vary. 2. Configure your matching and validation rules Set the conditions that determine whether an invoice is approved or flagged for review. You can compare fields such as PO numbers, supplier names, invoice totals, tax amounts, quantities, unit prices, or line items, and define acceptable tolerances for price or quantity differences. 3. Design the approval workflow Decide what happens after validation. Matching invoices can proceed directly to approval or payment, while documents with discrepancies are automatically flagged and routed for review. 4. Connect to your existing systems Integrate the workflow with your ERP, accounting software, procurement platform, or other business applications using APIs. Validated invoice data can be exported automatically, eliminating manual data entry. 5. Publish and run the workflow Hit publish and let the automation take over. Every incoming invoice is automatically processed according to the rules you’ve configured, ensuring consistent validation while reducing manual effort. Skip the setup. We’ll build it for you Send us a process you’re still doing by hand, and we’ll show you how it runs as one automated workflow. CONTACT US Frequently Asked Questions Whether you’re evaluating invoice matching automation or planning an implementation, these FAQs cover the questions businesses ask most often. How are invoice matching exceptions handled? When an invoice doesn’t meet your validation rules, it is automatically flagged and routed to the right reviewer. Your team can focus only on exceptions while compliant invoices continue through the workflow. How long does invoice matching take from data extraction to validation? The processing time depends on document volume, workflow complexity, and system integrations. With platforms like Fintelite AI, the end-to-end processes are typically completed in <3 minutes, allowing invoices to move through the approval process much faster than manual workflows. Can I implement complex validation rules for invoice matching? Yes. Fintelite AI makes it easy to create custom validation rules without coding. For example, you can compare line items, set price or quantity tolerances, detect duplicate invoices, and define approval conditions that match your business process. Is invoice matching limited to 2-way or 3-way matching? No. While 2-way and 3-way matching are the most common, you can also compare invoices with other supporting documents, such as contracts, delivery notes, or any documents required by your workflows

title: استثمر بمبلغ كبير، ولا أقسمه على أشهر؟⚖️
summary: 0:00/227.1361× يقولون العرب قديمًا "قليلٌ مستمر خيرٌ من كثيرٌ منقطع" وفي هذي المقولة نقدر نستنبط قاعدة استثمارية ينصح فيها معظم الخبراء الماليين. المعروف والمنطقي أنك تجمّع مدخرات بسيطة من كل شهر إلى ما يكون عندك مبلغ طيب تقدر تستثمر فيه ويرجع لك بعوائد متوقعة ممتازة،
body_text: 0:00 / 227.136 يقولون العرب قديمًا "قليلٌ مستمر خيرٌ من كثيرٌ منقطع" وفي هذي المقولة نقدر نستنبط قاعدة استثمارية ينصح فيها معظم الخبراء الماليين. المعروف والمنطقي أنك تجمّع مدخرات بسيطة من كل شهر إلى ما يكون عندك مبلغ طيب تقدر تستثمر فيه ويرجع لك بعوائد متوقعة ممتازة، أو أنك تشتري في هالمبلغ الطيب شيء معيّن مخطط عليه. لأن عندنا تصوّر مرسّخ أن الواحد إذا بيستثمر لازم يحط مبالغ ضخمة، ومن غير المنطقي أن مبالغ بسيطة ممكن تسوي أي شيء استثماري جيد. طيب وش الفرق بين الاستثمار بمبلغ ثابت شهريًا والاستثمار بمبلغ كبير مرة وحدة؟ خلونا ننظر للمقارنة من جانبين: جانب عاطفي/نفسي (سلوك المستثمر) و جانب مالي (أداء السوق) الجانب العاطفي/النفسي: الاستثمار بمبلغ ثابت شهريًا راح يساعدك على تكوين سلوك مستدام بالاستثمار والاهتمام لعزل مبلغ من دخلك الشهري للمستقبل، وبالإضافة إلى ذلك راح يساعدك تتجنب تأثير تقلبات السوق والأخبار اللي تسمعها في المجالس لو ترجع معي بالزمن لعام 2007م وتتخيل أنك مستثمر كبير في السوق الأمريكي تحديدًا في S&P500، راح تلاحظ أن المؤشر حقق عوائد عام 2007م 3.53%، بعدها بسنة وفي عام 2008م حقق خسائر -38.49%، الواضح من أداء عام 2008م أن أغلب المستثمرين كانوا متوقعين ان الاستمرار في الاستثمار راح يتسبب في خسارتهم وعلشان كذا قرروا أنهم يبيعون ويؤكدون الخسائر. طيب واللي صمل وش صار عليه؟ أبشرك أنه ارتفع أداء المؤشر من عام 2008م إلى عام 2023م بمقدار 377.20% على مدار الـ15 سنة. فاللي مستثمر بوتيرة أقل واستمرار أعلى كان أقدر على أنه يكمل ويصمل في استثماراته حتى مع نزول السوق وانهياره بعكس اللي جمّع مبلغ كبير ثم استثمره دفعة وحدة دون توزيع. أما الجانب المالي: ايييه وش أقولك عن الجانب المالي .. هنا الزبده على قولهم. فيه طريقتين، هي أنك تختار الأصول الاستثمارية بنفسك، أو تحطها مع مدير استثمار محترف (يعني مثل دراهم) المهم، اذا اخترت الأصول بنفسك راح تتعب في تحديد الأصول وكل فترة لازم تدخل على المحفظة وتتأكد أن أوزانها صحيحة وأن العوائد نزلت كاملة وتعيد استثمار العوائد بنفس النسب اللي حطيتها أول ويمكن تسمع أخبار عن سهم مصقع الدنيا وتحطه في محفظتك بس لأنك سمعت كم خبر حلو عنه، وليله طويلة مالها أول ولا آخر. طيب والمستثمر المحترف وش الزين فيه؟ وش الزين فيه! ، بأقولك .. بعد ماتضيف المبلغ راح يتأكد أن توزيع المحفظة صحيح وإذا جت عوائد استثمارية راح يعيد استثمارها بدون ما تدخل وتتعب نفسك، وزود على كذا يوفر لك طريقة تقدر تخلي الاستقطاع الشهري تلقائي بدون ماتشيل هم أنك شهريًا لازم تدخل على تطبيق البنك وتحوّل بشكل يدوي. وبخصوص إعادة الموازنة فتكون تلقائية بدون تدخل (بشري/ نفسي/ عاطفي) بل بأرقام وتحليلات مالية يوزّن لك بين الأصول ويرتبها لك. ختامًا، نتائج الاستثمار القليل المستمر مفيدة وفعّالة على الصعيدين النفسي والمالي، وتكوين عادة الاستثمار والاستقطاع الشهري هي من أبرز الأشياء اللي بتستفيد منها على المدى البعيد، على صعيدك الشخصي والمالي وكذلك الاجتماعي.

title: Pennsylvania American Water Begins Saxonburg Storage Tank Rehabilitation
summary: $1.1 million in total tank investments in 2025 and 2026 to improve service reliability, maintain water pressure and strengthen fire protection in Butler County SAXONBURG, Pa. (July 31, 2026) –...
body_text: $1.1 million in total tank investments in 2025 and 2026 to improve service reliability, maintain water pressure and strengthen fire protection in Butler County SAXONBURG, Pa. (July 31, 2026) – Pennsylvania American Water will begin rehabilitation of its 250,000-gallon elevated water storage tank located on Saxonburg Borough municipal building property in Butler County. These upgrades, part of the company’s $17.8 million statewide storage tank improvement plan , will strengthen service reliability and allow the company to deliver consistent water pressure and provide continued protection of water quality for customers. “Maintaining and rehabilitating water storage tanks, like this one in Saxonburg, is an efficient and cost-effective method to extend the life of critical infrastructure,” said Jake Gentile, senior director of operations for Pennsylvania American Water. The $416,300 project involves abrasive blasting and recoating of the interior and exterior of the tank, as well as a structural support evaluation and rehabilitation. This tank was last rehabilitated approximately 25 years ago. In addition to the Pennsylvania American Water logo, the company will add “Saxonburg” to the side on the elevated tank. Equipment staging has begun. Work will start the week of August 3, 2026, taking place Monday through Saturday between 7 a.m. and 7 p.m., and is expected to be completed by the end of October. The company expects no disruptions of water service to customers. This spring, Pennsylvania American Water also completed work on its 250,000-gallon West End storage tank in Butler Township, an $830,000 investment to continue providing customers in central Butler County with safe, reliable water service. "Water storage tanks play a key role in delivering the service our customers depend on every day," said Tony Nokovich, vice president of engineering at Pennsylvania American Water. "These improvements help maintain consistent pressure, support fire protection and ensure we can meet customer demand – both today and into the future." These infrastructure projects are not only an important investment in public health and safety, they also help support the economic vitality of the community. Research shows that for every $1 million invested in water infrastructure, upwards of 10 jobs are generated throughout the economy. Statewide, Pennsylvania American Water invested approximately $722 million in 2025 alone to improve its water and wastewater treatment and pipeline systems, supporting more than 7,220 jobs. The company's 2026 tank rehabilitation and construction projects will support more than 178 jobs. To learn more about Pennsylvania American Water's infrastructure investment efforts, visit pennsylvaniaamwater.com/infrastructure . About American Water American Water (NYSE: AWK) is the largest regulated water and wastewater utility company in the United States. With a history dating back to 1886 and celebrating 140 years in 2026, We Keep Life Flowing® by providing safe, clean, reliable and affordable drinking water and wastewater services to approximately 14 million people with regulated operations in 14 states and on 18 military installations. American Water's approximately 7,000 talented professionals leverage their significant expertise and the company's national size and scale to achieve excellent outcomes for the benefit of customers, employees, investors and other stakeholders. For more information, visit amwater.com and join American Water on LinkedIn , Facebook , X and Instagram . About Pennsylvania American Water Pennsylvania American Water, a subsidiary of American Water, is the largest regulated water utility in the state with approximately 1,200 dedicated employees working to provide safe, clean, reliable and affordable water and wastewater services to approximately 2.5 million people. Media Contact: Lauren Camarda External Affairs Manager Pennsylvania American Water 412-814-6505 lauren.camarda@amwater.com

title: Satu Pentas Untuk 376 Sekolah: Kedah Mulakan Juara Digital Pandai 2026
summary: Peluncuran Juara Digital Pandai Kedah dibawa keluar ke Star Parade Complex, Alor Setar, menyasarkan Guru Penggerak Digital dan Admin DELIMa.
body_text: Majlis Peluncuran Juara Digital Pandai Kebangsaan (JDP) 2026 Peringkat Negeri Kedah datang dengan pendekatan yang berbeza. Majlis ini tidak diadakan di dewan sekolah. Sebaliknya, ia berlangsung di Star Parade Complex, Alor Setar. Pemilihan lokasi ini bukan sekadar soal ruang. Dengan membawa peluncuran ke lokasi awam di tengah bandar, JDP 2026 di Kedah bergerak keluar daripada suasana majlis rasmi tertutup. Justeru, ia satu isyarat jelas — program ini memang direka untuk dilihat, dikongsi dan disebarkan seluas mungkin. Majlis berlangsung pada 7 Julai 2026 (Selasa) bermula sebelah pagi. Perasmi majlis ialah Encik Zahari bin Awang, Ketua Penolong Pengarah, Sektor Sumber Teknologi Pendidikan, Jabatan Pendidikan Negeri Kedah. Sekolah Dari Lima Daerah Berkumpul di Alor Setar Peluncuran di Kedah menghimpunkan sekolah dari lima Pejabat Pendidikan Daerah (PPD): PPD Kota Setar PPD Kubang Pasu PPD Pendang PPD Padang Terap PPD Yan Secara keseluruhan, majlis ini melibatkan 376 buah sekolah merentasi lima daerah tersebut. Sasaran Yang Spesifik: Guru Penggerak Digital dan Admin DELIMa Satu lagi perbezaan ketara dalam peluncuran Kedah ialah siapa yang dijemput. Majlis di negeri lain lebih menyasarkan guru kokurikulum atau murid. Namun, Kedah memberi fokus terus kepada Guru-guru Pentadbir, Admin DELIMa, dan 64 orang Guru Penggerak Digital (GPGD) seluruh negeri. Pendekatan ini strategik. Sebabnya, Admin DELIMa dan GPGD ialah orang yang paling dekat dengan sistem digital sekolah. Merekalah yang mampu menggerakkan penglibatan murid secara pukal, bukan seorang dua. Justeru, JDP 2026 di Kedah berpotensi bergerak lebih pantas dan lebih menyeluruh di peringkat sekolah. Kehadiran Rasmi dan Barisan VIP Selain sekolah dari lima daerah, majlis ini turut dihadiri: 50 wakil VIP Sektor Sumber Teknologi Pendidikan, merangkumi Timbalan Pengarah dan pegawai kanan JPN Kedah 11 pegawai Sektor Sumber dan Teknologi Pendidikan (SSTP), JPN Kedah 31 pegawai Unit Sumber dan Teknologi Pendidikan (USTP), PPD seluruh Kedah 64 Guru Penggerak Digital (GPGD) 5 wakil VIP Pandai Education Tambahan pula, turut hadir Encik Akmal bin Akhpah, Ketua Pegawai Teknologi (CTO) Pandai Education, bersama barisan Pengarah Pandai Education. Selain itu, hadir juga Encik Md Hasis bin Musa, Penolong Pegawai Pendidikan Daerah, Unit Sumber dan Teknologi Pendidikan, PPD Kuala Muda. Pendaftaran Tersusun, Dengan Sokongan Di Tempat Sebelum majlis bermula, guru-guru diminta mengimbas kod QR pendaftaran. Melaluinya, kehadiran direkod dengan kemas. Sekali gus, mereka layak menyertai sesi cabutan bertuah di penghujung majlis. Menariknya, pihak penganjur turut menyediakan meja bantuan khas di dalam dewan. Di sana, guru yang menghadapi masalah pendaftaran boleh terus mendapatkan bantuan. Selain itu, mereka juga boleh menyertai kumpulan WhatsApp rasmi di tempat. Detail kecil ini penting. Sebabnya, tiada seorang guru pun tertinggal daripada saluran komunikasi rasmi JDP 2026. Hasilnya, sekolah terus berhubung dengan pihak Pandai walaupun selepas majlis tamat. Majlis Dimulakan Dengan Lagu Negeri dan Bacaan Ikrar Majlis dimulakan dengan nyanyian ‘Negaraku’ dan lagu Negeri Kedah, ‘Allah Selamatkan Sultan Mahkota’. Seterusnya, bacaan Ikrar dipimpin oleh Encik Md Hasis bin Musa. Sesi bacaan Ikrar ini menambah satu lapisan komitmen kolektif. Bukan sekadar menghadiri, tetapi melafazkan kesediaan bersama. Selepas itu, bacaan doa dipimpin oleh Saudara Syamil Nazmi. Kemudian, majlis diteruskan dengan Bicara Aluan oleh Encik Akmal bin Akhpah. Gimik Peluncuran Dirakam Beramai-ramai Oleh Cikgu Kemuncak sesi formal ialah Gimik Peluncuran JDP 2026 Peringkat Negeri Kedah. Ia disempurnakan bersama oleh Encik Zahari bin Awang dan Encik Akmal bin Akhpah di atas pentas. Sebelum gimik bermula, guru-guru dijemput mengeluarkan telefon untuk merakam detik tersebut. Sebabnya, momen ini hanya berlaku sekali sahaja di Kedah tahun ini. Seterusnya, countdown dibuat beramai-ramai sebelum gimik disempurnakan. Selepas itu, tayangan montaj JDP 2026 diputarkan. Majlis kemudiannya diteruskan dengan penyerahan token penghargaan daripada Pandai Education kepada perasmi. Guru-guru turut digalakkan berkongsi rakaman di WhatsApp, Facebook dan Instagram. Malah, caption yang menonjolkan nama sekolah turut disarankan. Hasilnya, detik peluncuran tidak berhenti di Star Parade sahaja. Sebaliknya, ia terus bergerak ke komuniti sekolah seluruh Kedah. Taklimat Pelaksanaan: Sekolah Diberi Gambaran Penuh JDP 2026 Sesi taklimat disampaikan oleh Encik Zulfaqar Rosli, Pengarah Pandai. Melalui sesi ini, pihak sekolah diberi penerangan lengkap tentang pelaksanaan Juara Digital Pandai 2026. Antara fokus utama taklimat: mekanisme pertandingan fungsi dan ciri terbaru dalam aplikasi Pandai garis masa program ganjaran untuk murid dan sekolah peluang penglibatan pelajar di peringkat negeri dan kebangsaan Sepanjang sesi, hadirin digalakkan mengambil gambar paparan slaid. Dengan itu, maklumat penting boleh terus dibawa balik ke sekolah. Bagi Guru Penggerak Digital dan Admin DELIMa, sesi ini amat penting. Sebabnya, ia memberi gambaran jelas bagaimana JDP 2026 boleh digerakkan secara tersusun — bukan sekadar difahami, tetapi dilaksanakan. Sesi Cabutan Bertuah Tutup Majlis Dengan Meriah Majlis diakhiri dengan slot paling dinanti — Sesi Cabutan Bertuah. Ia khusus untuk guru dan pegawai yang mendaftar melalui kod QR di awal majlis. Hadiah yang disediakan: 5 hamper untuk guru dan pegawai 1 Smart TV 43 inci sebagai hadiah utama Pendekatan pendaftaran melalui kod QR ini memberi dua kelebihan sekali gus. Pertama, kehadiran direkod dengan kemas. Kedua, ia menjadi tiket automatik untuk cabutan bertuah. Bahan Hebahan Terus Sampai Ke Tangan Sekolah Sebelum bersurai, guru-guru dan wakil sekolah dijemput ke bahagian belakang. Di sana, mereka mendapatkan poster, Kit Hebahan JDP 2026, serta pek makanan untuk dibawa pulang. Namun, setiap sekolah perlu menyediakan kod sekolah sebelum mengambil poster. Langkah kecil ini penting. Ia memastikan setiap bahan hebahan sampai ke sekolah yang tepat dan boleh dijejaki. Tentang Juara Digital Pandai 2026 Juara Digital Pandai 2026 ialah pertandingan akademik digital dalam aplikasi Pandai. Ia terbuka kepada pelajar Malaysia berumur 7 hingga 17 tahun. Butiran utama pertandingan: Tempoh pertandingan: 1 Mei – 31 Ogos 2026 Grand Finale: 19 September 2026 Hadiah terkumpul: RM350,000 Pendaftaran: Percuma Kategori: Sekolah Rendah dan Sekolah Menengah Secara ringkas, pelajar akan belajar dalam aplikasi Pandai dan mengumpul Pandai Score. Selain itu, mereka bermain JDP Game, mendapatkan Ruby, serta naik tier dan leaderboard. Akhirnya, mereka mengumpul GF Points untuk peluang mara ke Grand Finale. Juara Digital Pandai Kedah Dah Ambil Langkah Berbeza — Kini Giliran Sekolah Peluncuran dibawa keluar ke ruang awam. Sasarannya pula ditujukan terus kepada Guru Penggerak Digital serta Admin DELIMa — orang yang paling mampu menggerakkan sekolah. Justeru, jelas sekali Kedah tidak mahu JDP 2026 berhenti sebagai satu majlis rasmi sahaja. Lima daerah sudah bergerak. Taklimat sudah disampaikan. Kumpulan WhatsApp rasmi sudah terbentuk. Poster dan Kit Hebahan pun sudah sampai ke tangan sekolah. Kini, cabaran sebenar bermula. Persoalannya — berapa ramai juara JDP 2026 yang bakal lahir dari Kedah tahun ini? Jangan Terlepas Pengumuman Pemenang Bulanan Setiap bulan, senarai pemenang Juara Digital Pandai 2026 dikemas kini. Justeru, sekolah dan murid boleh terus menjejaki kedudukan masing-masing sepanjang pertandingan berjalan. Klik butang di bawah untuk semak senarai terkini. Pengumuman Rasmi Pemenang Bulanan Juara Digital Pandai 2026 Countdown Bermula: Grand Finale Semakin Hampir Grand Finale Juara Digital Pandai 2026 berlangsung pada 19 September 2026 . Manakala tempoh pertandingan pula berakhir pada 31 Ogos 2026 . Grand Finale Juara Digital Pandai 2026 — Hari — Jam — Minit — Saat 19 September 2026 Masa terus berjalan. Oleh itu, setiap hari yang digunakan untuk menjawab soalan dan mengumpul mata membawa sekolah anda selangkah lebih dekat ke Grand Finale. title: Airlines Are Getting Creative With Upselling—and It’s Driving Revenue
summary: Airlines are beginning their digital transformation. With Gordian, they can add millions in revenue with world-class data personalization.
body_text: Getting there is half the fun. Given how miserable travel has been recently , that equation doesn’t hold much promise for how enjoyable this summer’s revenge vacations will be. But airlines want to make your journey more comfortable and convenient—for a price. ‍ Americans are traveling in droves as they try to make up for lost time during the pandemic, but that’s hardly been a windfall for the airline industry. All the major domestic airlines are trading down this year as they grapple with labor shortages , airport congestion and other capacity constraints at a time of record fuel prices—not to mention bad and downright violent behavior from customers. ‍ Those factors, along with worries of declining demand later this year and next, have weighed on investors’ minds. In the past month, analysts have been lowering their earnings per share estimates for either this year or next for key companies like American Airlines Group (AAL), Delta Air Lines (DAL), United Airlines Holdings (UAL), and Southwest Airlines (LUV), according to data from FactSet. ‍ The upshot is that airlines are have been getting more creative in finding incremental revenue. Enter the upsell. ‍ At this point, most travelers are aware that they have to pay more for things like extra legroom and early boarding, and the practice has already been built into analysts’ models for some airlines profits. ‍ Raymond James analyst Savanthi Syth recently upgraded Southwest to Strong Buy, arguing in part that the company’s “current initiatives should enable it to capture a greater share of corporate revenue (relative to 2019 levels), including through up-sell.” ‍ Indeed, the practice is proliferating, and provides a key incremental top-line driver for airlines looking to offset the pressures facing the industry. In 2009, just 5% of airline revenue came from this practice, but that figure has jumped to 15%. ‍ That figure jumps to 50% for some low-cost carriers, says Stephen Grabowski, co-founder and CEO of Gordian Software, which provides travel websites and airlines with the technology to sell add-ons. ‍ Traditional airlines like Delta are watching the success of low cost carriers like Spirit Airlines (SAVE) and Ryanair Holdings (RYA.Ireland) to see that “there are a lot more opportunities for them to monetize the flight journey and have been creating new products, like trimmed down basic economy cabin classes, as a result,” he tells Barron’s . “These all add up to meaningful margin gains for airlines that lean into them.” ‍ While amenities like early boarding and seat selection aren’t new, airlines are looking to expand this market, on everything from yearly subscriptions for extra leg room or tailored lounge access for travelers with long layovers. ‍ Moreover, Grabowski argues that airlines’ huge access to customer data isn’t harnessed at the moment—that’s why you get emails telling you to select a seat when you already have. Companies that can change this in the near future, and use data to personalize offerings, will see the biggest success by targeting offers tailored to travelers’ known preferences. ‍ In the end, that might not be welcome news for beleaguered travelers, who are already dealing with sky-high airfares and big delays. Yet it could offer some relief to airline shareholders. ‍ Write to Teresa Rivas at teresa.rivas@barrons.com
